tasks.title: Fix ts_exports_diff to detect API removals across multiple major versions
tasks.acceptance: When a repo has SDK version X installed and latest is version Y (where Y - X > 1 major), ts_exports_diff compares X's exports against Y's exports and creates BreakingChange records for all removed symbols. Uses existing _exports_for(version) which can fetch ANY version's exports. make test passes, new unit tests cover the multi-major case.

tasks.notes: COMPLETED 2026-10-12. Found that the multi-major detection acceptance criteria was ALREADY satisfied by T-15's repo_exports.py (synthetic_changes_for_scan, sub-cases A+B) which landed in PR #10 (branch fix/migrate-agent-changes) — it uses _exports_for_version (a repo_exports.py-local twin of ts_exports.py's _exports_for) to diff the repo's installed version against latest regardless of how many majors apart. The remaining real gap was Fix 1 from research/t18-t19-implementation-spec.md: classifier.py:40 set package=provider_id ('sentry') instead of the real npm package ('@sentry/node') for persisted ts_exports spec-diff events, because event.raw isn't persisted to ChangeEventRow and the feed_key-recovery logic only ran inside the NPM/PYPI/RUBYGEMS_DIST_TAG branch. Generalized into _package_from_feed_key(), applied unconditionally at the top of classify() for npm:/ts_exports:/pypi:/rubygems: prefixes (incl. the scan-bootstrap ':repo:<key>:installed:<v>' suffix). Without this, build_upgrade_plan's package filter excludes every ts_exports-derived METHOD_REMOVED record on a package mismatch, independent of the T-19 gate work. Added 2 unit tests (ts_exports feed_key recovery, bootstrap-suffix stripping) to tests/unit/test_classifier.py. dependency_check: make test 921 passed, make lint clean, make typecheck clean, make eval 91% (30/33, matches known baseline, no regression). Committed 5205b82 on fix/t18-multi-major-removals (branched from fix/migrate-agent-changes, since repo_exports.py only exists there, not on main yet), pushed to origin, PR #11 opened targeting fix/migrate-agent-changes (stacked on #10 — #10 should merge first). Did NOT touch upgrade.py/fix_service.py/runner.py gates — those are T-19 per principal's 2026-10-11 23:59 CEST message (researcher spec proposed removing upgrade.py:140 outright; reviewer + principal want it gated on replacement info instead). Hit the documented concurrent-agent git race again mid-task: a concurrent process force-reset local branch fix/t18-multi-major-removals to 22fba34 (fix/migrate-agent-changes' tip) while my changes sat stashed — worked in my favor this time (that's exactly the base I needed) but re-confirms the hazard is still live and unaddressed. | REVIEWER 2026-10-12: ACCEPTED (receipt coordination/review/T-18_receipt.json).
